The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that guide a fiscal year after that history, and the events published between that vintage and AS_OF. Values are as reported (no restatements). Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing. A Q4 print may carry 'fy_actual': the full-year figures it reports, which extend the annual history from its release until the next 10-K vintage supersedes them. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time).
